**Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the full base, not the discounted amount. Its own doc comment said tax goes on what the customer pays. Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so the bug only showed on rows with both.

Fixed at [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) by taxing `discounted`.
